name: io.github.holistis/trust-attest-server
description: Owner-requested endpoint trust attestations: prove control of an endpoint, get a passive check run, receive a signed, expiring EndpointAttestation.

environmentVariables.description: The attester's own EIP-191 signing key (0x-prefixed private key). Required for a persistent identity across restarts; if unset, the server falls back to a fresh random key every start (loud warning, not fit for real use).
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_ATTEST_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: HMAC secret behind the ownership-challenge token, at least 32 characters. Required alongside TRUST_ATTEST_PRIVATE_KEY for a persistent identity.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_ATTEST_OWNERSHIP_SECRET
